name: The "Crack" Trail
why: Killarney's best-known hike: it should be offered from its own trailhead to the viewpoint, under its name. OSM's relation stops 1.5 km short of the viewpoint; routes offers the viewpoint only by a 17.9 km approach from Cranberry Bog, and gives the name to a 3.6 km hike to Kakakise Lake.

name: Chikanishing Trail
why: Day-use trail to a wave-washed point on Georgian Bay.

name: Cranberry Bog Trail
why: Day-use trail past bogs and marshes; partly on the La Cloche Silhouette.

name: Granite Ridge Trail
why: Day-use trail to two lookouts over the La Cloche Mountains.

name: Lake of The Woods Trail
why: Day-use loop around Lake of the Woods (in the neighbouring Killarney Lakelands park in OSM).

name: The Crack
why: Killarney's best-known hike, up to the Crack's viewpoint and back (6 km return).
